-- S8 keeps Planner admission separate from executable course planning. This
-- Teacher-owned ledger is a bounded command/outbox and notification checkpoint;
-- it contains no Student profile, prompt/model body, or opaque graph payload.
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_state_check,
    DROP CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_check;

ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_state_check
        CHECK (state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'superseded', 'completed', 'closed', 'handoff_pending')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_onboarding_interaction_check
        CHECK (
            (state = 'active'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL)
            OR (state = 'reserved'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL
                AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
            OR (state = 'handoff_pending'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL
                AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason = 'planning_ready' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL
                AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
            OR (state = 'superseded'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL)
            OR (state = 'completed'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NOT NULL
                AND reservation_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')
                AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
                AND closed_reason IS NULL AND closed_at IS NULL
                AND ((reservation_mode = 'onboarding_action' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)
                    OR (reservation_mode = 'onboarding_text' AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL)))
            OR (state = 'closed'
                AND reserved_teacher_job_id IS NULL AND reserved_action_receipt_id IS NULL
                AND reservation_mode IS NULL AND superseded_by_interaction_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL
                AND closed_reason IN ('planning_ready', 'active_path_exists') AND closed_at IS NOT NULL)
        );

CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (
    handoff_intent_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (student_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'),
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    source_teacher_job_id UUID UNIQUE REFERENCES teacher_dialog_job(teacher_job_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    source_interaction_id UUID REFERENCES teacher_onboarding_interaction(interaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    command_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    command_teacher_job_id UUID NOT NULL,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    state_ref_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_kind IN ('accepted_draft', 'finalized_profile')),
    state_ref_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (state_ref_version > 0),
    goal_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (goal_code IN ('programming.foundation', 'go.backend')),
    goal_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (goal_version = 'v1'),
    graph_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL CHECK (graph_version IN ('programming-foundation-graph-v1', 'go-backend-graph-v1')),
    locale VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL CHECK (locale IN ('ru', 'en')),
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'dispatching', 'accepted', 'message_pending', 'delivered', 'active_path', 'blocked')),
    claim_token UUID,
    locked_by VARCHAR(128),
    locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ,
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    planner_handoff_id UUID UNIQUE,
    notification_command_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    notification_message_id UUID UNIQUE,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(64),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    readiness_observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    delivered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    FOREIGN KEY (personal_teacher_id, student_id) REFERENCES personal_teacher(id, student_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CHECK ((source_teacher_job_id IS NULL) = (source_interaction_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((goal_code = 'programming.foundation' AND graph_version = 'programming-foundation-graph-v1')
        OR (goal_code = 'go.backend' AND graph_version = 'go-backend-graph-v1')),
    CHECK ((status IN ('dispatching', 'message_pending')) = (claim_token IS NOT NULL AND locked_by IS NOT NULL AND locked_until IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status IN ('dispatching', 'message_pending') OR (claim_token IS NULL AND locked_by IS NULL AND locked_until IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((planner_handoff_id IS NULL) = (accepted_at IS NULL)
        AND (planner_handoff_id IS NULL) = (readiness_observed_at IS NULL)),
    CHECK (status <> 'accepted' OR planner_handoff_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('queued', 'dispatching', 'active_path') OR planner_handoff_id IS NULL),
    CHECK ((status = 'delivered') = (notification_message_id IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status <> 'blocked' OR last_error_code IS NOT NULL)
);

-- The ledger's command/audit identity is write-once. Lifecycle checkpoints
-- remain mutable so a claimed command can retry, receive Planner's ACK, and
-- record its idempotent Dialog delivery without ever changing what was sent.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    IF ROW(
        OLD.handoff_intent_id, OLD.student_id, OLD.personal_teacher_id, OLD.dialog_id,
        OLD.source_teacher_job_id, OLD.source_interaction_id, OLD.command_id,
        OLD.command_teacher_job_id, OLD.request_hash, OLD.state_ref_kind,
        OLD.state_ref_version, OLD.goal_code, OLD.goal_version, OLD.graph_version,
        OLD.locale, OLD.notification_command_id
    ) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(
        NEW.handoff_intent_id, NEW.student_id, NEW.personal_teacher_id, NEW.dialog_id,
        NEW.source_teacher_job_id, NEW.source_interaction_id, NEW.command_id,
        NEW.command_teacher_job_id, NEW.request_hash, NEW.state_ref_kind,
        NEW.state_ref_version, NEW.goal_code, NEW.goal_version, NEW.graph_version,
        NEW.locale, NEW.notification_command_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding handoff identity is immutable';
    END IF;

    -- Planner and Dialog acknowledgements are evidence, not mutable cache.
    -- Their first complete write is permitted; subsequent retries may only
    -- observe it, never clear it or substitute another acknowledgement.
    IF OLD.planner_handoff_id IS NULL AND OLD.accepted_at IS NULL AND OLD.readiness_observed_at IS NULL
       AND NEW.planner_handoff_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status <> 'accepted' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding Planner acknowledgement must be recorded on acceptance';
    END IF;
    IF (OLD.planner_handoff_id IS NOT NULL OR OLD.accepted_at IS NOT NULL OR OLD.readiness_observed_at IS NOT NULL)
       AND ROW(OLD.planner_handoff_id, OLD.accepted_at, OLD.readiness_observed_at)
           IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.planner_handoff_id, NEW.accepted_at, NEW.readiness_observed_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding Planner acknowledgement is immutable';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.notification_message_id IS NULL AND OLD.delivered_at IS NULL
       AND NEW.notification_message_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status <> 'delivered' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding Dialog acknowledgement must be recorded on delivery';
    END IF;
    IF (OLD.notification_message_id IS NOT NULL OR OLD.delivered_at IS NOT NULL)
       AND ROW(OLD.notification_message_id, OLD.delivered_at)
           IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.notification_message_id, NEW.delivered_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding Dialog delivery acknowledgement is immutable';
    END IF;

    IF NOT (
        (OLD.status = NEW.status)
        OR (OLD.status = 'queued' AND NEW.status = 'dispatching')
        OR (OLD.status = 'dispatching' AND NEW.status IN ('queued', 'accepted', 'active_path', 'blocked'))
        OR (OLD.status IN ('accepted', 'active_path') AND NEW.status = 'message_pending')
        OR (OLD.status = 'message_pending' AND NEW.status IN ('accepted', 'active_path', 'delivered', 'blocked'))
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding handoff status transition is invalid';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity
BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_identity();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding handoff evidence cannot be deleted';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_delete();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'teacher onboarding handoff evidence cannot be truncated';
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate
BEFORE TRUNCATE ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff
FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_truncate();

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_student_state_key
    ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (student_id, state_ref_kind, state_ref_version);

CREATE INDEX teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_dispatch_idx
    ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (next_attempt_at, created_at, handoff_intent_id)
    WHERE status IN ('queued', 'dispatching');

CREATE INDEX teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff_message_idx
    ON teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff (next_attempt_at, created_at, handoff_intent_id)
    WHERE status IN ('accepted', 'active_path', 'message_pending');

COMMIT;
